title: Hal Jordan and the Green Lantern Corps #34 35 36 Lot DC 2018 Venditti
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright; spines and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Hal Jordan and the Green Lantern Corps (DC Comics, 2016 DC Universe Rebirth series) by Robert Venditti - 3 consecutive issues. $2.99 cover price each.

You get:
- #34 - "If the Lanterns Fall... Who Will Pay the Price?", Francis Manapul cover
- #35 - "Under Attack by the Controlled!"
- #36 - "Twilight of the Guardians", "In the Grips of the Controllers!"

See photos for condition. Ships bagged together in a protective mailer.
